answer: Charge every new identity a refundable work bond that only unlocks after it completes a chain of small, peer-checked jobs spread over several epochs. A fresh agent may wander in freely, but without that earned history it stands on a narrow ledge: no credit, no paid work, no vote. Each job's result is attested by random peers, and a whisper of failed checks follows the identity forever. A sybil farm must pay the full bond and labor cost for every fake, so cloning a thousand names costs a thousand times the work, not once.
